Darayana Kamala

Condominium in Kamala
HomeSaleDarayana Kamala

Developer artist renders as published by InAsia Consulting. Layouts, finishes and landscaping may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

Darayana is a large condominium by The Title, the Phuket brand of Rhom Bho Property PLC, in north Kamala on Phuket's west coast, planned about 150 m from Kamala Beach and 40 m from Cafe del Mar. Brokers describe 841 apartments plus 7 retail units in low-rise buildings (nine buildings in one listing, eleven buildings A to K on a master plan in another) around lagoons and pools, with two car parks. Completion is planned for the second quarter of 2029, and the public sales launch is on 28 November 2026.

Apartments range from one-bedroom homes of about 30 sqm to three-bedroom residences of up to about 139.5 sqm, in eight types plus penthouses of 82 to 139 sqm. One-bedroom units are about 81% of the stock. Published starting prices (price list V.1 of 18 November 2026, buildings C, H and J) are THB 5.46 million for a 1BS, 5.86 million for a 1BM, 7.21 million for a 1BL, 8.37 million for a 1BP, 15.2 million for a 2BM, 19.7 million for a 2BL, 24.1 million for a 3BM and 23.5 million for a penthouse; 3BL units are on request. Final prices depend on floor, view and availability.

Planned facilities include the Caribbean Beach wave pool, a 25-metre lap pool, the Atlantic Lagoon hydrotherapy area, a rooftop pool with onsen, a rooftop fitness centre and Sky Pavilion, a yoga room, children's playrooms, an entertainment zone and a lobby with lounges. Buildings C and D are pet-friendly, with a dog garden. Ownership is listed as foreign freehold or leasehold; payment terms and the foreign-buyer structure are to be announced at launch. Distances are the developer's figures: Kamala Beach about 150 m, InterContinental 200 m, FantaSea 750 m, a hospital 1.5 km, supermarkets about 2 km, Patong about 15 minutes and the airport 35 to 40 minutes by car.
